method: Public DOM actions and imported test fixtures; diagnostics read only. No gameplay mutation through browser evaluation.

checks.name: Startup never probes a cloud endpoint
Refit works with real colon-containing IDs
Retuning uses separate effect and full item identifier
Slot filter shows only the selected slot
Bulk preview lists only the selected unprotected shell
Bulk salvage keeps refitted, alternative-family and rare items
Directed craft produces a relic through actual UI
Explicit cloud upload returns a recovery code
Recovery secret is absent from all network URLs
Unavailable service leaves local inventory intact
Cloud snapshot restores refit and chosen effect
Quality low/high/low has no WebGL sampler or shader errors
Restored world renders at low quality without particles
No JS exceptions in feature flow
